_privacy_warning.issue: ActionGetHomeData embeds a per-record `User` object containing Username, External_Id (9-digit Banner ID), Last_Login and a Password key (empty in all observations); Submission also carries SubmittedByExternalId.
_privacy_warning.action_required: DailyMail must drop `User` and all *ExternalId fields at ingest and never persist them.

tls.defect: server omits intermediate certificate; stock clients fail verification
tls.leaf_subject: C=US, ST=New Jersey, O=Rowan University, CN=apps.rowan.edu
tls.missing_intermediate: C=US, O=Internet2, CN=InCommon RSA Server CA 2
tls.recommendation: pin the InCommon intermediate in a custom CA bundle; keep verification enabled; do NOT disable TLS verification

version_tokens.note: All discoverable at runtime; rotate on Rowan redeploy. Collector should re-discover rather than hardcode.

moduleVersion.mismatch_behaviour: tolerated; full data still returned, hasModuleVersionChanged=true

apiVersion_GetHomeData.source: regex AnonymousCSRF-style scan of /RowanAnnouncer/scripts/RowanAnnouncer.MainFlow.Home.mvc.js for callServerAction("GetHomeData", "<path>", "<apiVersion>")
apiVersion_GetHomeData.mismatch_behaviour: SILENT FAILURE: HTTP 200 with data:{} and hasApiVersionChanged=true

csrf_token.nature: OutSystems platform-wide anonymous constant, not a secret, not per-session
csrf_token.bogus_value_behaviour: HTTP 200 with full data - only header PRESENCE is validated

Audience.invalid_value_behaviour: SILENT: returns only the Audience=='Both' subset instead of erroring

Category.note: changes the URL; not needed by DailyMail

api_level.Filters.EndDate: 1900-01-01 = single-day sentinel; a real date switches to inclusive RANGE mode
api_level.Filters.keywords: free-text search, empty for full listing
api_level.MaxRecords: page size; UI always sends 20; honoured up to at least 100000; <=0 raises 'Error executing query.'

links.note: non-absolute values are malformed author input, not site-relative paths; trim whitespace and leading   and prepend https:// for scheme-less hosts

body_html_characteristics.sanitisation_rationale: none observed in 1756 bodies, but bodies are author-supplied so must be enforced defensively
encoding_notes: emoji present in titles and bodies

date_behavior.range_mode: EndDate == real date (inclusive; matches any announcement with >=1 distribution date in range)

recommended_collector.with_optional_element_of: D - hybrid; a weekly (non-critical-path) Playwright cross-check of TotalCount and category chips

rejected.B_html_parsing: impossible - index HTML is a 2.3 KB React shell with no announcement data
rejected.C_playwright_dom: demonstrated silent data loss: 20 of 27 announcements rendered on 2025-03-05; also slower, more fragile, and returns FEWER fields (no DistributionDates, no approver metadata)
rejected.claude_vision_or_nl_browsing: explicitly not recommended as primary collector; deterministic extraction is fully available

recommended_collector.daily_plan: 2 POSTs to ActionGetHomeData (Employees + Students), single-day mode, MaxRecords=500, runtime token discovery, pinned TLS bundle

required_validation_rules.name: structural validity gate
assert: 'TotalCount' in data and parses as int >= 0
required_validation_rules.rationale: a genuine empty day returns a FULL 33-entry Categories list; a broken call returns data:{}. This is what distinguishes 'no announcements' from 'collector failed'.

required_validation_rules.name: count reconciliation
assert: sum(int(c.Count) for c in Categories) == int(TotalCount)

required_validation_rules.name: truncation suspicion
required_validation_rules.action: if equal, re-query with larger MaxRecords or paginate even if counts agree

required_validation_rules.name: audience echo
required_validation_rules.rationale: an invalid Audience silently returns only the 'Both' subset instead of erroring

required_validation_rules.name: date echo
assert: requested date is parseable YYYY-MM-DD before sending
target_date in record.DistributionDates for every record
required_validation_rules.rationale: an unparseable CurrentDate silently falls back to today

required_validation_rules.name: identity integrity
assert: SubmissionIds unique within a single-day result

required_validation_rules.name: required fields soft
assert: if Event then EventName non-empty and EventDate != '1900-01-01'

required_validation_rules.name: employee/student parity
assert: audience class from Audience field == audience class from set membership across the two calls

required_validation_rules.name: change detection
assert: hash(Title, FullBody, Category, Audience, Event*, Contact*, DistributionDates) compared to stored
flag hash change with no UpdatedDate change as suspicious

required_validation_rules.name: trend guard
assert: not (today == 0 and trailing 14 days all non-zero)
no implausible swing in totals or category counts

required_validation_rules.name: transport validation
assert: TLS verification succeeds against pinned InCommon bundle
required_validation_rules.note: report TLS failure distinctly from HTTP failure

required_validation_rules.name: token drift
assert: log discovered token set each run
